conservation.note: diagnostics only, never a training term; the box is fixed and the outer flux is integrated rather than assumed zero

selection_criteria: lexicographic, fixed before the final test set is seen: (1) non-physical / inadmissible state count, (2) squared hinge of the physics and interface residuals against the section 16 tolerances, (3) development-set prediction error, (4) training loss. Lower is better at every level.
